title: Campaign ROI overstates revenue after cancellations
description: Exclude canceled orders from revenue. Update the revenue model and its downstream test documentation and dashboard definition.
acceptance_criteria: Revenue excludes canceled orders; SQL tests documentation and dashboard agree.
ba_notes: Discussed in the weekly campaign review. BA and Finance agreed the policy and target date; campaign budget decisions depend on the corrected figure.

title: Refund policy for CRM revenue reporting
description: Exclude refunded orders from revenue. Update the revenue model and its downstream test documentation and dashboard definition.
acceptance_criteria: Revenue excludes refunded orders; SQL tests documentation and dashboard agree.
ba_notes: CRM owner confirmed the business rule in the intake meeting. Useful for the next retention report; no urgent budget decision is blocked.

title: Net sales metric for Finance reconciliation
description: Exclude canceled and refunded orders from revenue. Update the revenue model and its downstream test documentation and dashboard definition.
acceptance_criteria: Revenue excludes canceled and refunded orders; SQL tests documentation and dashboard agree.
ba_notes: BA reconciled terminology with Finance. Excluding cancellations and refunds is agreed; review the changed dashboard definition before sign-off.

title: Pending-payment treatment in EC reporting
description: Exclude canceled and pending orders from revenue. Update the revenue model and its downstream test documentation and dashboard definition.
acceptance_criteria: Revenue excludes canceled and pending orders; SQL tests documentation and dashboard agree.
ba_notes: EC operations raised this in Slack. BA is still confirming how long an order may remain pending; do not start delivery until the definition is agreed.

title: Legacy revenue dashboard cleanup
description: Exclude refunded and pending orders from revenue. Update the revenue model and its downstream test documentation and dashboard definition.
acceptance_criteria: Revenue excludes refunded and pending orders; SQL tests documentation and dashboard agree.
ba_notes: User and BA agreed to defer this cleanup until campaign reporting and month-end requests are complete.

title: Completed-order revenue view
description: Exclude canceled and refunded and pending orders from revenue. Update the revenue model and its downstream test documentation and dashboard definition.
acceptance_criteria: Revenue excludes canceled refunded and pending orders; SQL tests documentation and dashboard agree.
ba_notes: Historical synthetic example. Already delivered; keep it in the register for traceability and exclude it from new intake selection.

title: Dormant-shopper audience extract for a CRM campaign
description: Prepare a synthetic audience extract for shoppers with no purchase in the last 90 days. The CRM team needs a reviewed segment definition and demonstration counts before planning the next campaign.
acceptance_criteria: BA-approved segment definition; synthetic hashed customer IDs only; audience counts reconciled to the agreed rule.
ba_notes: Consultation completed with CRM. Consent filters and the demonstration column list are agreed. Requires implementation scoping beyond the revenue-policy MVP.

title: New checkout funnel dashboard for EC operations
description: Create a new dashboard showing sessions, checkout starts and completed orders by device. The EC team wants to investigate checkout friction after the platform redesign.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard owner, conversion definition and reporting timezone still need agreement with BA.
ba_notes: Raised in a planning meeting. Discovery session is not scheduled yet; metric definitions are not ready for delivery.

title: Investigate a mobile-push attribution mismatch
description: Investigate a difference between synthetic mobile-push delivery records and the campaign performance report. BA needs an agreed comparison window before the next spend review.
acceptance_criteria: Agree a timestamp convention and collect a reproducible synthetic example before proposing a correction.
ba_notes: Urgent business conversation, but the input evidence is incomplete. BA is requesting example events and a common timezone from the user.

title: Multi-source sales and delivery extract for an internal pack
description: Create a new synthetic multi-source extract combining daily sales, store and currency reference data, and external shipping delivery records. Finance wants to replace a monthly internal copy-and-paste pack; the existing manual workaround is usable and no statutory close or customer decision is blocked.
acceptance_criteria: Document the agreed output columns and source ownership; reconcile sales totals and explain shipping joins using synthetic records; estimate new model and source work before scheduling implementation.
ba_notes: User and BA agreed the objective and desired layout. Ready for scoping only: new source ingestion and cross-source models are absent from the sample repository. Lower-impact convenience work may be deferred; volume and delivery dates require engineering assessment.
